topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: So, my neighbor turns out to be a walking vault, huh? Figures. All this time, I've been drowning in my measly little routine, while they've been living like kings behind closed doors. The nerve, keeping it all so quiet. You'd think they'd want to show off, maybe throw a few extravagant parties to remind the rest of us peasants of our place. But no, they just sit there, letting their gold rust, while we all toil away. Classy, if you can call it that. I suppose there's no point in wondering what they've got to hide; it's their little fortress, and I'm just the guy outside, trying to scrape by.
